text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — external pen test (PT-2025) is kicking off next week. Need to lock RBAC change window, KMS proxy plan, and audit-log extraction steps. Tentative window: Wed 2025-05-20 09:00-13:00 PT. Who can own evidence packaging and retest queueing?

samir: I can own evidence packaging. Can someone confirm whether we want ephemeral assessor roles or a cross-account read-only role?

yara: lean toward ephemeral roles for least-privilege during the live window. We'll need an ops play to mint a short-lived role + KMS grant for the assessor. Also: what retention slice do we need to export? PT ticket requests 90 days of audit logs sampled around the window.

matt: 90d sounds fine. For export, we'll provide a pre-signed S3 bucket and a scoped KMS DEK wrapped with customer-managed key. Quick export command we can provide to assessors (example):

```
# export CloudWatch logs for PT window (example)
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/inference --start-time 1759814400000 --end-time 1759821600000 > pt-evidence-logs.json
```

ops-oncall: Plan for ops: we'll create a timeboxed IAM role `pt-assessor-ephemeral` that expires after 4 hours. Steps: 1) create role in staging with read-only inline policy; 2) add a condition restricting source IPs to the reading room; 3) pre-create S3 path `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/PT-2025/` and hand out presigned PUT URLs. I'll set up a runbook checklist.

elaine: @ops-oncall please attach that runbook to PT-2025 ticket and ping here. Also, confirm whether we need KMS key rotation prior to the test (some assessors asked to see key metadata).

osps-oncall: typo - meant @ops-oncall :D

ops-oncall: For KMS, we won't rotate keys just before the test (avoid breaking envelopes). We'll capture key metadata and key policy snapshot and upload to the evidence bucket. Yara — do you want the KMS grant to be scoped to Encrypt/Decrypt or only Decrypt for the DEK unwrap?

yara: Only Decrypt for the wrapped DEK during the evidence retrieval flow. Also need audit-log sampling policy: prefer continuous logs for the 4h window plus 1h buffer each side. We should enable enhanced logging (request/response metadata) for the timebox.

samir: I'll create a small script to SHA256 the exported artifact and include a manifest with timestamps and command used. Will upload manifest to S3 path and add ticket link.

elaine: Also coordinating retest slots — propose two back-to-back 1hr slots: Tue 2025-05-27 09:00-10:00 PT and Thu 2025-05-29 14:00-15:00 PT. @matt can you confirm infra availability for staging probe during those slots?

matt: Staging is free for both. Suggest we mark the second slot as a contingency. I'll block capacity and mark autoscale off for the slots to avoid noisy metrics.

elaine: Great. One more ask: create a minimal IAM policy name `pt-assessor-readonly` with only List/Get on the S3 evidence prefix and CloudWatchReadOnly for logs. Yara, can you draft the policy text?

yara: Drafted in the PT ticket — will include a tiny policy snippet in the runbook. Sample role name: `redwood-pt-assessor-readonly`. Will also add a KMS grant step: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <KMS_KEY_ID> --grantee-principal <role-arn> --operations Decrypt` and then revoke after the window.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: `infra/staging` autoscale disabled for 2025-05-27T09:00Z to 2025-05-27T11:00Z per request from matt.

samir: Added evidence packaging checklist to PT-2025 (INC-4821). Items: logs export, key-metadata, manifest+sha256, evidence upload, presigned URLs.

elaine: Perfect. Can everyone react with :+1: once you've uploaded your assigned artifacts to the S3 path? We'll do a short preflight 1 hour before the test (run through the checklist). Thanks all — trying to avoid the usual last-minute rush for retest rendezvous and the retask-staging-probe steps.

matt: +1

yara: +1

samir: +1

ops-oncall: I'll post the runbook link in the ticket and schedule the preflight.

elaine: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if any blockers crop up.
